output.title: Optional annotation-copy flag; no Ingress or Gateway manifests in environment
output.content: The release notes describe a new controller option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, that lets you choose annotation keys to copy from an Ingress or Gateway onto the Certificate it produces. The notes call it a new option and do not say any existing behaviour changes. In the supplied environment, only the values keys global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled, prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort and replicaCount are set. The manifests contain only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, with no Ingress or Gateway resources, so nothing shown would use this option. If the cluster has annotated Ingress or Gateway resources that weren't included in these inputs, check them before deciding whether to turn the option on.
